final: WITH funding_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS spatial_record_count FROM scanspatial AS ss JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT *, SUM(spatial_record_count) OVER () AS total_count, AVG(spatial_record_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM funding_counts) SELECT fundflux, spatial_record_count, CAST(spatial_record_count AS REAL) / total_count AS share, spatial_record_count - average_count AS above_average FROM totals WHERE spatial_record_count > average_count
